title: Cherrypicking Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare input CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that includes a header line and the following columns in this exact order: ,clone ID,0ur plate ID,Source Labware,Source Slot,Source Well,Source Aspiration Height Above Bottom (in mm),Dest Labware,Dest Slot,Dest. Plate ID,Dest Well,Volume (in ul). Populate each row with the sample data, for example: n1,CL-1418591,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,2,B06,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,11,RAILPB03,A01,15; n2,CL-1418640,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,2,D12,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,11,RAILPB03,A02,15; n3,CL-1418621,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,2,H09,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,11,RAILPB03,A03,15; n4,CL-1418715,2,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,3,H09,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,11,RAILPB03,A04,15; n5,CL-1418738,3,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,4,A01,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,11,RAILPB03,A05,15; n6,CL-1418818,3,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,4,A11,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,11,RAILPB03,A06,15; n7,CL-1418744,3,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,4,G01,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,11,RAILPB03,A07,15; n8,CL-1418866,4,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,5,C05,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,11,RAILPB03,A08,15; n9,CL-1418976,5,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,6,C07,1,biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr,11,RAILPB03,A09,15; … Include as many rows as needed for your experiment. The protocol uses a P20 single‑channel pipette. A template CSV can be downloaded from https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/0df680/ex.csv.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select any required custom labware files (with .json extensions) to upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol script (a .py file) to the Opentrons App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange all labware on the robot deck exactly as specified by the deck map for the cherrypicking run.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate each piece of labware, the tip rack, and the P20 single‑channel pipette. Refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.
